scope.kind: Unequal PDF row measure counts plus encoded-change comparison

encodedDurationImplementation.rule: Each explicit bar divides slotsAvailable by the number of chord tokens. Slash continues the previous chord by one such slot; the next named chord starts a new event.

method.measureUnit: All starts/ends are zero-based bars; meter remains separately sourced.
method.selection: Inventory every song with more than one distinct source-row bars value. Use existing matched official Impro-Visor leadsheet path as a comparison, not authority to overwrite PDF content. These files may encode different arrangements.
method.comparison: Parse the first chords part, explicit bar separators, equal within-bar slots and slash continuation. Compare PDF/encoded time over the shorter available span, testing a constant12-way root transposition. Report duration-weighted root and exact normalized harmony agreement separately.
method.harmony: Exact normalized harmony uses root pitch class, declared compound interval list and explicit slash bass. Source qualities are not silently simplified; F#o and F#o7 differ. Unknown/clipped tokens are mismatches, not wildcards.
method.boundaries: Adjacent exactly equal harmony cells coalesce for timing-boundary comparison, avoiding graphical repeated carry letters. No source or playback data is mutated.
method.limit: Matching barcount alone does not prove matching chords; sampled root agreement does not prove exact voicing or traditional form. Unequal PDF source-row lengths are graphical wrapping, not section lengths by themselves.

house.title: A House is Not a Home
house.qualityExplanation: Three F#o quarter-bar cells in the PDF correspond to F#o7 at encoded lines44,52,69: triad intervals[0,3,6] versus seventh[0,3,6,9]. Timing is identical. Ab7#11 and Ab7#11_ have equal declared intervals; that spelling difference is not a timing change.
house.finding: No House extraction timing error found. Its38 bars and10+10+8+10 phrase lengths are encoded explicitly and agree with the original PNG and current data. The PDF uses one fixed bar grid and leaves blank space after4- and6-bar rows. Normalizing every displayed short row to full width causes apparent stretching; fix row geometry rather than changing chord durations.
